title: Orchid Liquid Plant Food
description:
Dosage

1 pump (~2mL) for 0.75L of water. (The cap is 4.5mm!)

How to Use

1. Fill your watering can.
2. (Optional) Let water sit for 24 hours to reach room temperature and allow chlorine to evaporate.
3. Shake well and add fertiliser to the watering can.
4. Water plants as normal.

Tips

  • Fertilize every time you water to maintain stable soil chemistry.
  • Forget to fertilize? No problem! Just resume next time.
  • Use half the dosage in fall/winter or when plants stop growing.
  • Do not exceed the recommended dosage.
  • Use within 48 hours after mixing with water.
  • Do not use this fertiliser the first 180 days after repotting with SYBASoil!

*We do not recommend using this as a foliar spray, as residue will build up on the leaves.

Orchid BIO Liquid Plant Food

Liquid Orchid Plant Food is the simplest way to give your orchids the gentle, balanced nourishment they need for healthy roots, vibrant leaves, and long-lasting flowers. This orchid bio fertilizer is specially designed to mimic the natural conditions orchids love, delivering essential nutrients in a clean, plant-safe formula. From Phalaenopsis to Cymbidium and Dendrobium, every orchid thrives with this orchid liquid fertilizer, crafted to make feeding effortless and effective.

Why Orchids Need Something Different

Orchids are beautiful but also demanding. Regular soil or standard fertilisers often miss the mark, either by overwhelming delicate roots or by failing to deliver the right nutrients. That is where this orchid nutrient solution makes the difference. With a balanced ratio of nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium, plus essential trace minerals, it supports flowering, strengthens stems, and healthy root growth. As an organic orchid food, it nourishes gently while protecting the natural rhythm of your plant’s growth.

Three Easy Ways to Feed Your Orchid

No matter how you grow, there is a perfect fit for your setup:

  • BIO Liquid: A fast-acting orchid plant booster that mixes directly with water for quick absorption. Perfect for regular care.
  • BIO Slow Release: Organic pellets that break down gradually, offering long-lasting support with minimal effort. Best for bark-based media.
  • Regular Slow Release: A formula created for mineral substrates, such as SYBAStones, ensuring your orchid receives balanced nutrition without disrupting the mix.

Each version of this orchid growth liquid is made to deliver consistent, reliable feeding so your plants stay strong and resilient.

Clean and Eco-Conscious

At Sybotanica, we believe that caring for plants should also care for the planet. This orchid care fertilizer is made with eco-friendly ingredients and sustainable methods, making it safe for both your plants and your home environment. With every application, you are not just feeding your orchid, you are choosing orchid organic nutrients that work in harmony with nature.

Trusted by Orchid Lovers

What began with hands-on experimentation has grown into a product trusted across Europe. The orchid bio feeding options from the SYBASupport range reflect years of learning what orchids truly need. Thousands of plant lovers already use this orchid natural fertilizer to achieve healthier roots, stronger stems, and more spectacular blooms. With Sybotanica, you feed with confidence, knowing your orchids are getting the highest quality care.
